[joe-john] Are these NAS drives good for back up data offline? New parent here and I just wanted to have something to securely store my child's photos and videos🤔
[Mechz] That's literally what they're designed for.
[oooooooo ahhhhhhh] NAS drives are designed for 24/7 usage not offline backup.
They will do fine as offline drives but it's not what they were designed for.
[Lexdysic] What drives are designed specifically for offline backup?
[schquid] @Lexdysic: Tape. Some optical mediums as well.
[krisspy] Why not?
Wd reds I've inherited from a workplace came with 21k power on counts over 18000 hours. I've since had them on running 24/7 on a nas for 2 years now.
Greens/blues are not built better than reds, they don't do anything special that makes them more resistant to power cycles.
People confuse the whole cycling thing on/off. It's better to keep it running vs turning on hibernate/sleep on your server, which can potentially save you 10-20 power cycles a day. It was never "don't use a red for normal pc use or it'll blow up".
Reds will wear just as much as greens during power cycles.
Reds are built to a higher standard with better vibration reduction (hence the longer warranty).
Reds cost as much as greens in this economy - might aswell get reds.
[oooooooo ahhhhhhh] @krisspy:
Why not?
Why not what? All I'm saying is that NAS drives are designed to be powered on 24/7.
[davidl222222] looks like you want cold storage, only access it from time to time?
these are NAS drive designed for constant access…to be used in NAS server, hence the price tag might be slightly higher than the regular drives(if available at discount too!)
